text: City Council directed the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer to report to the April 1, 2020 City Council Meeting on opportunities to provide First-Time Home Buyer with greater relief from the Municipal Land Transfer Tax. This includes the maximum price eligibility threshold of $400,000 to reflect increased home prices in Toronto. The rebate offsets the tax on up to $400,000 of the purchase price.
City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020, referred Item EX14.5 to the November 17, 2020 meeting of the Budget Committee for further consideration.
